gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve a list of local incoming phone numbers associated with my Twilio account so that I can manage my phone numbers effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of local incoming phone numbers, including details such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to create a new local incoming phone number for my Twilio account so that I can receive calls and messages on it.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters for the desired area code and return the details of the newly created local phone number, including its SID and status.
